thread:
Nova Fern: hi everyone! 👋 I’m Nova — joining as Site Reliability Engineer (they/them). I like sourdough, terrible puns, and collecting ferns. excited to be here!
Sam Pizza: welcome Nova!! :tada: will you fight me for the best kombucha flavors in the fridge?
Nova Fern: only if you bring the lilypad flavor, it's my weakness. also i can never keep office plants alive, so if the fern starts leaning pls blame me in advance 😂
Juno: hi Nova! we have a monthly plant swap in the kitchen. low chance of survival, high chance of cute pots.
Keiko: quick logistics — badge, laptop, and welcome kit should be at the front desk. @Nova Fern did people ops confirm your T-shirt size?
Nova Fern: yes 2XL if they stock the soft ones :)
Dev-Bot: Nova Fern was added to #new-hires and given access to onboarding docs, check the Getting Started thread.
Arlo Toast: lunch meetup today at 12:30? we usually do a sandwich run.
Nova Fern: I’ll join! also friendly poll: coffee, tea, or kombucha for morning fuel? vote with emoji :
Sam Pizza: :coffee: (coffee forever)
Juno: :tea:
Keiko: :bento: (i pick whatever's left)
Harper Lin: :sake: (jk) Welcome again Nova, ping me when you want a tour of the monitoring dashboards or if you want to shadow an oncall rotation.
Nova Fern: thanks all! looking forward to the kitchen chaos and meeting y'all in person :green_heart:
